title: Aeronautics Playground
description: Featuring create aeronautics, aeronautics add-ons, distant horizons, minimal vanilla enhancement and optimization mods
body:
Minimal sandbox oriented modpack for experimenting with the new create aeronautics mod with multiplayer compatibility in mind. This could be creating airplanes, offroad mining vehicles, submarines you name it. Distant horizons, terrain generation, optimizations and other shader eye candy is included for convenience.

Note that aeronautics plus addons are new mods, some of which **could be unstable** and the same can be said about this modpack. I included the bleeding edge version of mods where possible to keep up with the hype. Opinionated addons such as *sable: collision damage* (contraption breaking mechanism) has been included.

Suggested java arguments for distant horizons: `-XX:+UseZGC` (related to chat warning)

Tested with 8GB memory.

If you see striped pattern on unloaded landscapes, use FULL mode in distant horizons world generator settings as explained [in this post](https://www.answeroverflow.com/m/1399487449024954458)

On server it's suggested to use `/dh pregen start overworld 0 0 300` to pregen 300 chunk radius world, in singleplayer after world generation keep the game running and DH should do the rest.
